title: SpaceX Inspiration4 Urine Inflammation Panel (Multiplex, NULISAseq)
description: The SpaceX Inspiration4 mission was a 3-day mission with four private astronauts to low Earth orbit that occurred in September 2021. The crew collected biospecimen samples before, during, and after flight. One of these biospecimen collections included urine from pre-flight and post-flight/recovery timepoints (L-92, L-44, L-3, R+1, R+45, R+82). 203 inflammatory, cytokine, and chemokine proteins were quantified using NULISAseq. This study derives results from the Multiplex assay, and the urine data in this study are related to other studies using data from the same experiment; OSD-569 (whole blood), OSD-570 (peripheral blood mononuclear cells), OSD-571 (plasma), OSD-572 (skin, oral, and nasal swabs),
OSD-573 (Dragon capsule samples), OSD-574 (skin biopsy), OSD-575 (serum), and OSD-630 (stool).
publications: The Space Omics and Medical Atlas (SOMA) and international astronaut biobank
Collection of Biospecimens from the Inspiration4 Mission Establishes the Standards for the Space Omics and Medical Atlas (SOMA)

No se descargaron mediciones individuales ni se entrenó un modelo.
Organismo humano no demuestra que toda muestra sea de un astronauta; revisar población, material y diseño del estudio.
Resumen de campos de la fuente, no análisis ni validación científica de sus resultados.
